title: [docdb] Querying master UI before leader is elected can deadlock master leader startup
body:
Jira Link: [DB-2511](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-2511)
Master leader stuck thread on startup:
```
Thread 23 (LWP 1458):
#0  0x00007f6d85b61a0a in futex_wait (private=0, expected=0, futex_word=0x1d7641c) at ../sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/futex-internal.h:61
#1  futex_wait_simple (private=0, expected=0, futex_word=0x1d7641c) at ../sysdeps/nptl/futex-internal.h:135
#2  __pthread_rwlock_wrlock_slow (rwlock=rwlock@entry=0x1d76410) at pthread_rwlock_wrlock.c:67
#3  0x00007f6d85b675e8 in __GI___pthread_rwlock_wrlock (rwlock=rwlock@entry=0x1d76410) at pthread_rwlock_wrlock.c:124
#4  0x00007f6d8a184cca in yb::RWMutex::WriteLock (this=this@entry=0x1d76410) at ../../../../../src/yb/util/rw_mutex.cc:130
#5  0x00007f6d9334e6cd in lock (this=0x1d76410) at ../../../../../src/yb/util/rw_mutex.h:89
#6  lock_guard (__m=..., this=<synthetic pointer>) at /tmp/testing/yugabyte-2.1.1.0/linuxbrew-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/Cellar/gcc/5.5.0_4/include/c++/5.5.0/mutex:386
#7  yb::master::CatalogManager::VisitSysCatalog (this=this@entry=0x1d76000, term=term@entry=1) at ../../../../../src/yb/master/catalog_manager.cc:650
#8  0x00007f6d9334fa32 in yb::master::CatalogManager::LoadSysCatalogDataTask (this=0x1d76000) at ../../../../../src/yb/master/catalog_manager.cc:617
#9  0x00007f6d8a1a54c4 in yb::ThreadPool::DispatchThread (this=0x19c7e00, permanent=false) at ../../../../../src/yb/util/threadpool.cc:608
#10 0x00007f6d8a1a1bcf in operator() (this=0x4fa3258) at /tmp/testing/yugabyte-2.1.1.0/linuxbrew-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/Cellar/gcc/5.5.0_4/include/c++/5.5.0/functional:2267
#11 yb::Thread::SuperviseThread (arg=0x4fa3200) at ../../../../../src/yb/util/thread.cc:744
#12 0x00007f6d85b63694 in start_thread (arg=0x7f6d745b4700) at pthread_create.c:333
#13 0x00007f6d852a041d in clone () at ../sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/x86_64/clone.S:109
```

Example curl thread waiting on response:
```
Thread 22 (LWP 1510):
#0  0x00007f6d852975cd in poll () at ../sysdeps/unix/syscall-template.S:84
#1  0x00007f6d868c7e9c in Curl_poll () from /tmp/testing/yugabyte-2.1.1.0/lib/yb-thirdparty/libcurl.so.4
#2  0x00007f6d868c2eab in curl_multi_wait () from /tmp/testing/yugabyte-2.1.1.0/lib/yb-thirdparty/libcurl.so.4
#3  0x00007f6d868be4e7 in curl_easy_perform () from /tmp/testing/yugabyte-2.1.1.0/lib/yb-thirdparty/libcurl.so.4
#4  0x00007f6d8a092764 in yb::EasyCurl::DoRequest (this=this@entry=0x7f6d5dc89b70, url=..., post_data=..., content_type=..., dst=dst@entry=0x7f6d5dc89bc0) at ../../../../../src/yb/util/curl_util.cc:134
#5  0x00007f6d8a0931ce in yb::EasyCurl::FetchURL (this=this@entry=0x7f6d5dc89b70, url=..., buf=buf@entry=0x7f6d5dc89bc0) at ../../../../../src/yb/util/curl_util.cc:71
#6  0x00007f6d933ed6e3 in yb::master::MasterPathHandlers::RootHandler (this=<optimized out>, req=..., output=0x7f6d5dc89e20) at ../../../../../src/yb/master/master-path-handlers.cc:952
#7  0x00007f6d90fa9596 in operator() (__args#1=0x7f6d5dc89e20, __args#0=..., this=<optimized out>) at /tmp/testing/yugabyte-2.1.1.0/linuxbrew-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/Cellar/gcc/5.5.0_4/include/c++/5.5.0/functional:2267
#8  yb::Webserver::RunPathHandler (this=this@entry=0x1c4a000, handler=..., connection=connection@entry=0x5b9b000, request_info=request_info@entry=0x5b9b000) at ../../../../../src/yb/server/webserver.cc:370
#9  0x00007f6d90faa44a in yb::Webserver::BeginRequestCallback (this=0x1c4a000, connection=0x5b9b000, request_info=0x5b9b000) at ../../../../../src/yb/server/webserver.cc:313
#10 0x00007f6d90fbde46 in handle_request () from /tmp/testing/yugabyte-2.1.1.0/lib/yb/libserver_process.so
#11 0x00007f6d90fc09ee in worker_thread () from /tmp/testing/yugabyte-2.1.1.0/lib/yb/libserver_process.so
#12 0x00007f6d85b63694 in start_thread (arg=0x7f6d5dc94700) at pthread_create.c:333
#13 0x00007f6d852a041d in clone () at ../sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/x86_64/clone.S:109
```

Would probably be useful to at least set _some_ timeout on our requests :)

https://curl.haxx.se/libcurl/c/CURLOPT_TIMEOUT.html
